descr: Apple desktop and laptop computers running macOS.

name: PlayStation 4
descr: Sony's previous-generation home console, released in 2013.

name: Xbox Series X|S
descr: Microsoft's current-generation family of home consoles, released in 2020.

descr: Microsoft's previous-generation home console, released in 2013.

name: Nintendo Switch
descr: Nintendo's hybrid console that works both docked to a TV and as a handheld.

descr: Nintendo's handheld console featuring glasses-free stereoscopic 3D.

name: iOS
descr: Apple's mobile platform for iPhone and iPad.

name: Android
